assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness accompanied by a recent history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks.
Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmic etiologies contributing to these neurological and vestibular symptoms.
This service is medically necessary given the documented recurrent dizziness and giddiness along with the recent transient cerebral ischemic attacks requiring evaluation for arrhythmia.
